requirements.requirement: The system must extract credential and taxonomy fields from NPI provider data returned by provider_detail_service.
The system must identify board certification entries from credential text using deterministic parsing rules or keyword matching (e.g., 'board certified', specialty boards).
The system must normalize extracted certification names into a consistent format for comparison (e.g., lowercase, trimmed, standardized tokens).
The system must map provider taxonomy codes to human-readable specialties for relevance comparison.
The system must compute a relevance score between extracted board certifications and the queried specialty using taxonomy alignment or keyword similarity.
The system must assign a higher relevance score when certification specialty exactly matches the queried specialty than when it partially matches.
The system must return a zero or minimal relevance score when certifications are unrelated to the queried specialty.
The system must support multiple certifications per provider and compute an aggregate relevance score based on the best or combined match.
The system must output structured data including extracted certifications and computed relevance score in accordance with the schema defined in EVAL-BOARD-ST-001.
The system must handle missing or empty credential fields by returning no certifications and a default relevance score without throwing an error.
The system must handle malformed or unstructured credential text by skipping unparseable entries and continuing processing for valid ones.
The system must ensure scoring logic executes deterministically given the same input data and queried specialty.
The system must complete extraction and scoring within acceptable backend latency thresholds consistent with provider_detail_service performance.
The system must not modify or overwrite original NPI data fields during extraction and scoring operations.
